title: Exceptional lessons start with connection
description: Opening brand lockup for the funding pitch.
speakerNotes: Open on the CCD mark. Calm and confident. Line: Exceptional lessons start with connection. Pause. Let the brand land before the case.

title: Arts teachers are working alone
description: The funding problem — fragmented practice and invisible arcs.
speakerNotes: Arts teachers — drama, dance, music — are still stitching years from PDFs, drives and last year's tabs. Often the only specialist in the building. Great practice gets lost. Non-specialists are left guessing. This is the gap funding must close.

title: A connection layer for the arts
description: Why CCD: hubs, national partners, classroom craft.
speakerNotes: CCDesigner is the connection layer. Music Hubs. National arts partners. Classroom craft. One workspace so sector expertise reaches the teacher who needs it on Tuesday morning — not as another website to remember, but as planning they already do.

title: Music hubs in Partner Hubs
description: EMS, Tri-Borough, LSO — regional and national music in one home.
speakerNotes: Partner Hubs puts Music Hubs and organisations in one place. Essex Music Service for Greater Essex. Tri-Borough pathways. LSO packs teachers can open and add. Regional delivery and national excellence — side by side.

title: From hub to library
description: LSO Add to CCDesigner — trusted content into the teacher's library.
speakerNotes: Open a hub. Choose a resource. Add to CCDesigner. That is the moment funding buys: sector content landing inside the teacher's living library — not a dead download on a desktop.

title: Partner packs and personal resources
description: Add from hubs and create personal resources.
speakerNotes: Teachers also add their own. Video. Links. Backing tracks. Notes. Partner packs and personal resources sit together — so the scheme is both sector-backed and school-owned.

title: Starter, main, plenary — one hour
speakerNotes: Then they build the lesson. Starter. Main. Plenary. Example activities dragged into place. Cap: sixty minutes. One hour. Real timetable. No three-hour fantasy plans — teachable craft for a real day.

title: Lessons become a whole unit
description: Scheme of work / half-term unit on the planner.
speakerNotes: Lessons stack into a whole unit. Assign to a half-term. See the arc across six weeks. How to Build an Orchestra. Romeo and Juliet. Whatever the hub and the teacher invent together — visible as a journey, not a pile of files.

title: Calendar and key dates
description: Week view with lessons and partner key dates.
speakerNotes: The calendar holds it. Lessons on the week. Partner key dates — concerts, workshops, inset — teal on the same grid. The living timetable where hubs and schools meet.

title: PDF export and share
speakerNotes: Then leave with the work intact. PDF export for the room. Share a link with a colleague. Calendar export for cover and leaders. Proof that the arts were planned — and delivered.

title: Celebrating learning in the arts
description: Surfacing craft for parents, leaders and the sector.
speakerNotes: This is how we celebrate learning in the arts — not as a one-off showcase, but as daily craft made visible to parents, leaders, hubs and the wider sector.

title: Fund the connection layer
speakerNotes: The ask: fund the connection layer between hubs and classrooms. Support CCDesigner so Music Hubs and arts organisations put practice where teachers already plan. Visit ccdesigner.co.uk. Contact rob at rhythmstix.co.uk. Book a thirty-minute funder walkthrough. End clean. Hold the brand.
